components.css: .ds-btn{min-height:2.875rem;padding:0 1.5rem;border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:0.5rem;background:var(--c-action);color:var(--c-on-action);font-family:var(--font-board);font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.04em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0.25rem 0 var(--c-action-deep);transition:transform 140ms var(--ease-out),box-shadow 140ms var(--ease-out)}.ds-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 calc(0.25rem + 2px) 0 var(--c-action-deep)}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(0.25rem);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--c-action-deep)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--c-line);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: The site is a metro line diagram. A light green field is the ground; white enamel sign panels carry content in dark green ink behind a 2px edge; one mid-green route line ties the pieces together. Open stops are solid, planned stops are dashed with an amber hatch.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed uppercase station-board headings over Barlow body
Hard-offset pressable buttons and 2px ink edges
Solid line = open, dashed + amber hatch = planned

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: There is one route colour. It is a stroke (lines, rings, focus), not a fill for large areas.

rules.name: The Green Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are tinted toward hue 130-152. Pure white, black and gray are not used.

rules.name: The Hatch Means Planned Rule
rules.body: The amber diagonal hatch and dashed strokes mean not built yet or work in progress, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Board Voice Rule
rules.body: Condensed uppercase is for headings, buttons and route labels. Running text and form labels stay in Barlow sentence case.

rules.name: The Thickness Rule
rules.body: Raised means a hard offset in a solid colour. A blurred shadow alone never signals elevation.

dos: Do put content on enamel panels over the green field, with a 2px ink edge and the hard thickness shadow.
Do mark tools that do not exist yet with dashed strokes, soft-ink labels and the amber hatch.
Do use condensed uppercase for headings, buttons and route labels.
Do write colour as tokens only; each is a single light-dark() declaration.
Do keep focus visible: 3px route-green outline with 3px offset.
donts: Don't build a dark-terminal homelab dashboard or a rounded-card SaaS page.
Don't use gray or pure white/black.
Don't use blur, glow or glass for elevation.
Don't use route green as text colour on the field.
Don't use the amber hatch for anything but planned/in-progress.
